final: WITH station_phase AS (SELECT t.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_usage, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage), phase_summary AS (SELECT lunarstage, AVG(avg_usage) AS avg_station_usage, SUM(record_count) AS phase_count FROM station_phase GROUP BY lunarstage), overall_total AS (SELECT SUM(phase_count) AS total_count FROM phase_summary) SELECT p.lunarstage, p.avg_station_usage, p.phase_count, 1.0 * p.phase_count / total.total_count FROM phase_summary AS p JOIN overall_total AS total ON total.total_count IS NOT NULL
